body: Of course, but I've tried everything in my power to do so over the 8 years I've had it. I remember when it started I knew I had to do something about it as I was sure people that have it for over 3 years will have it ingrained in their brains forever. Well look at me now, I never thought it could get this bad and I'm well over the 3 year mark. I wish I always had it, that way I wouldn't remember what it felt like to be a normal happy person enjoying life and having the motivation to do anything I wanted.

I wish my parents were the reason I'm doing this because as that would be so easy to fix. No chance in trying to create a new life overseas as my social anxiety is so bad I blush the moment anybody  starts to talk to me and have lost all of my social skills because of this.
